Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Muter
Punchline: Mutes noisy crowds, specific people and the emotes you never want to hear.
Description:
Tired of noisy crowds? Will-o-Muter mutes the Ambient Sounds channel when many players are nearby and restores your volume once the crowd thins out.

It can also silence the voices of specific people (right-click them in chat or in the world), everyone of a race or gender, and emotes you pick, with a WhiteList for people who should never be muted.

Open the settings with /willomuter.
